[Module: Login | TC-012 | Type: Edge/Input | Priority: Medium]
Title: Username with leading and trailing whitespace authenticates successfully

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/login
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": " standard_user ",
  "password": "secret_sauce"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Login page; user is not authenticated

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter ' standard_user ' (one leading space and one trailing space) in the Username field
  2. Enter 'secret_sauce' in the Password field
  3. Click the Login button

Expected Result:
  Whitespace is trimmed; authentication succeeds; user is redirected to the Product Inventory page; no error banner is displayed

Notes from prior verification:
  No steps changed. Trimming and authentication behavior are runtime behaviors not verifiable from the static DOM snapshot.
